announcement.title: Instant gallery and update center
announcement.message: Random mode can now change wallpapers from local stock immediately. Settings also includes update checks and a direct Google Play link.

announcement.messageZh: 随机模式现在可以从本地库存秒换壁纸；设置页新增检查更新和直达 Google Play 的入口。

releaseNote: Cloud-driven content, native page composition and Manager Picks roulette; compatible optional fields for older apps.

homeModules.bodyEn: Fresh landscapes, cities and starry skies.

roulettes.suffix: 保持环境题材为主，按以上所选场景自然决定尺度，构图、光照和配色与以上选择保持一致；如需人物，人物仅作小比例原创背影或剪影点景，空间结构与透视连贯。原创插画，不复刻具体作品或已知角色；无文字、标志、水印，适合竖屏手机壁纸。

prefixes.hathway_worldbuilding: 店长推荐，视觉参考：JohnHathway；An intricately drawn fantasy world built from dense layers of architecture and mechanical structures. Fine ink-like outlines, precise perspective and selective flat color describe elaborate believable forms, with clear differences in scale and carefully spaced areas of detail
prefixes.tokyo_genso_reclaimed_city: 店长推荐，视觉参考：东京幻想（Tokyo Genso）；A lifelike architectural environment matte painting of a familiar city reclaimed by nature. Weathered concrete, intricate foliage and clear water have convincing three-dimensional surfaces, coherent reflections and accurate perspective. Crisp nearby detail softens into atmospheric distance, creating a quiet, dreamlike and thriving environment
prefixes.mocha_atmosphere: 店长推荐，视觉参考：mocha；A luminous Japanese landscape painting with oil-paint-like brushwork and a vast sense of space. Broad visible strokes build volumetric clouds and distant landforms, while smaller painted strokes describe nearby natural details. Warm lit planes, cool shadow masses and soft atmospheric transitions create a serene, slightly dreamlike environment
prefixes.mocha_atmosphere_wilderness_summer_open_: 店长推荐，视觉参考：mocha；A spacious Japanese anime environment painting with visible oil-paint-like brushwork, large calm shapes, rich luminous color and clearly layered atmospheric distance
prefixes.waisshu_grand_scale: 店长推荐，视觉参考：わいっしゅ（Waisshu）；A cinematic fantasy environment concept painting combining believable architectural structure with extraordinary natural scale. Volumetric landforms, textured painted materials and atmospheric distance create monumental depth; intricate detail is concentrated around the principal structure within strong large shapes
prefixes.waisshu_grand_scale_wilderness_wide_upla: 店长推荐，视觉参考：わいっしゅ（Waisshu）；A spacious Japanese anime environment painting with visible oil-paint-like brushwork, large calm shapes, rich luminous color and clearly layered atmospheric distance
prefixes.fujiwara_color_fantasy: 店长推荐，视觉参考：藤ちょこ（fuzichoco）；A finely detailed Japanese fantasy illustration with delicate decorative patterns and luminous layered color. Transparent color transitions, intricate foliage and ornamental surfaces form a dreamlike environment. Rich jewel-like hues have clear dominant areas and restrained accents, with fine local edges and readable spatial layers
prefixes.shinkai_sky_light: 店长推荐，视觉参考：新海诚（Makoto Shinkai）；A refined Japanese animated-film background painting with intricately observed environmental detail. Volumetric clouds have clearly modeled lit edges and cool shadow planes, while lucid atmospheric gradients, natural reflections and softly receding distance give the scene cinematic emotion and convincing depth
prefixes.shinkai_sky_light_wilderness_undeveloped: 店长推荐，视觉参考：新海诚（Makoto Shinkai）；A spacious Japanese anime environment painting with visible oil-paint-like brushwork, large calm shapes, rich luminous color and clearly layered atmospheric distance
prefixes.reference_grand_garden_world: 店长推荐，视觉参考：店长提供的宏伟花园世界图片；An immersive cinematic fantasy environment matte painting with lifelike three-dimensional materials and subtle hand-painted finishing. Intricate natural foliage, weathered mineral surfaces, transparent water, coherent refraction and fine surface detail create convincing depth. Nearby textures are clearly resolved while distant layers softly recede, forming a luminous and awe-inspiring garden world
prefixes.nik_daily_city: 店长推荐，视觉参考：NIK（JP NIK / nik_jyp）；A finely painted Japanese everyday environment illustration with believable street perspective and layered architecture. Carefully observed windows, eaves, utility wires and plants form intimate living details. Fine painted textures and selective crisp edges in the foreground soften into the distance, combining accurate structure with a clear, inviting atmosphere
prefixes.pippi_painterly_water: 店长推荐，视觉参考：ぴっぴ（pippi913）；A narrative environment painting with clearly visible brushwork and rich natural surface detail. Broad, solid light-and-shadow planes give rocks, wood and plants convincing volume, while smaller strokes resolve nearby texture. Warm lit accents contrast with cool shadows, and clear coherent reflections give water depth; any tiny original traveler remains a minor environmental accent
prefixes.pasoputi_emotional_space: 店长推荐，视觉参考：pasoputi（pasopuchi）；An expressive painted environment illustration capturing a quiet moment through space and color. Believable perspective connects buildings, sky and intimate everyday details; carefully arranged light and shadow create visual rhythm. Soft painted transitions are balanced with clear selective edges, preserving calm atmosphere and readable environmental depth
prefixes.bocuden_clear_background: 店长推荐，视觉参考：BoCuden；A clear, finely detailed Japanese background painting with believable architectural structure and carefully observed plants. Clean layered gradients in the sky and water combine with intricate nearby everyday detail and softly receding atmospheric distance. Rich but deliberately placed color creates a quiet, lucid environment
prefixes.bocuden_clear_background_wilderness_gold: 店长推荐，视觉参考：BoCuden；A spacious Japanese anime environment painting with visible oil-paint-like brushwork, large calm shapes, rich luminous color and clearly layered atmospheric distance
prefixes.banishment_blue_surreal: 店长推荐，视觉参考：banishment；A precise Japanese surreal environment illustration where familiar everyday architecture meets one carefully defined impossible spatial relationship. Real street surfaces and coherent perspective remain believable around the fantasy element; sky and reflections create deliberate visual displacement. Fine environmental detail, deep tonal layers and selective local light preserve a clear, quietly strange atmosphere
prefixes.hotaka_lit_city_corner: 店长推荐，视觉参考：hotaka；A finely painted Japanese nighttime environment illustration focused on an intimate street corner. Layered eaves, weathered walls, paving and windows establish continuous near-to-middle-distance perspective. Localized warm light pools contrast with cool ambient shadows; delicate surface textures and selective crisp detail remain readable within the quiet night
prefixes.houtei9_white_fantasy: 店长推荐，视觉参考：河底9（Houtei9 / hohtei9）；A delicate fantasy environment painting built around pale architectural surfaces. Believable three-dimensional shading blends with finely visible painted texture; intricate material details and natural plants organize the nearby space. Familiar architecture contains subtle speculative details, while softly receding layers create an airy, intimate environment
prefixes.pentaro_star_night_reference: 店长推荐，视觉参考：ペンたろう（提供图片参考）；An original painted nighttime environment inspired by the supplied starry-sky reference. A vast deep night sky forms the principal visual space, with naturally varied star sizes and unevenly grouped star density. Softly layered land or architectural silhouettes and a few small warm lights establish scale, depth and a quiet balance of cool and warm color
prefixes.pentaro_star_night_reference_wilderness_: 店长推荐，视觉参考：ペンたろう（提供图片参考）；A spacious Japanese anime environment painting with visible oil-paint-like brushwork, large calm shapes, rich luminous color and clearly layered atmospheric distance

composition.prompt: 竖幅广角远景，天空或地貌形成大尺度主视觉，地平线偏下，顶部留出呼吸空间
高位斜俯视，保留远方地平线，前中后景形成清楚的空间层次
较低机位向远处仰望，以近景与云层或巨构的尺度差增强冲击感
用近景植物或岩石局部框景，核心景观完整可见，画面向远处展开
河道、路径或地形边缘自然引导视线进入远景，主景偏离正中央
街角或环境中景，适度靠近主体，屋檐、墙面与道路组织亲切的空间，不强求远方地平线
建筑与环境的局部构图，选择窗台、转角或阶梯作为主视觉，边缘自然延伸到画外
竖幅天空构图，星空或云幕占据主体，下方少量地景提供尺度，天空细节自然分布
从地面或屋顶向上望，近处屋檐与远处天空形成尺度差，不添加无关巨构
以环境中的水面或玻璃倒映形成主视觉，保留真实场景的一角，倒影方向和空间关系连贯
A level, unobstructed distant view. A low remote horizon sits in the lower third; expansive sky and continuous open land or water dominate, with sparse low foreground texture
A level, sweeping view toward a very distant horizon in the lower quarter. Broad open sky fills most of the vertical canvas, while a thin uninterrupted foreground leads freely into the distance
